title: A sharp density bound for 5-connected graphs with no $\Ke$ minor
summary: Let $\Ke$ be obtained from $K_7$ by deleting two independent edges. We prove that every 5-connected graph on $n\ge7$ vertices with at least $4n-9$ edges contains a $\Ke$ minor, settling Conjecture~1.4 of Dvo\v rák, Norin and Rahman (arXiv preprint 2609.17760v1). The bound is sharp. We prove the stronger statement that every $4$-bilight graph on $n\ge4$ vertices with at least $4n-9$ edges contains either a $\Ke$ minor or a $K_6$ subgraph.
